title: Young Woman Crouching with Baby on Steps, 1938 California Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
747 A

FADE PROOF
AUG 29 1938
Finished by B. D. WOOD
Fullerton, California
description: A charming candid snapshot taken outdoors in the bright summer sunshine of late August 1938. A smiling young woman or older sister in a floral summer dress squats on the concrete front steps of a wooden clapboard home, holding a plump infant or toddler in a pale smock dress on her lap. Beside them are lush bushes and a large window with divided lights. The back bears a blue processing stamp dated August 29, 1938, developed by B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California.
